entries.gap: Xyce harmonic balance has no autonomous (oscillator) mode, no HB noise analysis and no .pss.
entries.symptom: An oscillator in HB converges to the DC state with no error.
entries.workaround: Find the oscillator steady state with a probe loop (an ideal source at the oscillation node; its frequency and amplitude are adjusted until the probe current is zero). Phase noise: impulse sensitivity function from transient runs.
entries.evidence: xyce adapter guard (warning: no port has signal); reference design tool-chain stage 0

entries.gap: With .step and HB, one failed step aborts the run and shifts the blocks of the CSV output.
entries.symptom: Values of a sweep point belong to another point, with no error at the point.
entries.workaround: Run one sweep point per Xyce process (the hb operation of the xyce adapter does this).

entries.gap: A YLIN (S-parameter) device is an open circuit outside harmonic balance, with no warning.
entries.workaround: Fit the Touchstone data to a passive SPICE subcircuit (touchstone adapter, fit_to_spice). The xyce adapter refuses YLIN with these analyses.

entries.gap: Xyce ignores .temp (only a warning) and keeps the first .param definition.
entries.symptom: The run is at 27 C, or a later parameter value is not used.
entries.workaround: Use temp_c and params of the xyce adapter: it writes them before the deck and runs with -redefined_params usefirst. The adapter refuses .temp.
